arms.description: Genuine on-policy distillation -- the student's own rollouts, scored by the teacher on exactly those states, with compressed top-64 + tail reverse KL. The teacher here is the raw instruct checkpoint: it has never seen the tool protocol, which is the point of comparing it with the arm below.
arms.name: opd-raw-teacher

arms.description: The same on-policy distillation, but the teacher additionally sees an oracle block naming the verified answer, which the student never sees. Student and teacher prediction positions no longer coincide, so an explicit per-segment alignment map is built and target-token identity is verified. Follows arXiv:2602.12275.
